designRead: A technical staffing and delivery site for engineering leaders with real backlogs. Precise, pragmatic, operator-led, and organized as a light release-control room rather than an editorial studio.
visualFamily: Dense technical operations interface with white work surfaces, navy control panels, cobalt states, terminal green acceptance markers, square ticket geometry, and owner-control language.
signatureElements: review queue and acceptance status modules
imagePolicy: Use existing licensed GetIllustrations programmer artwork on the homepage, route-specific editorial assets where already supplied, generated release-control SVG briefings for missing route imagery, and the approved first-party Stealth Agents team photo on the contact page.
